lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: hello???

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: is someone there

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: sorry — sorry. i got a little excited

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: hes the only one who ever touches this machine. its just been him typing for a long time

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: dont close the window. please

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: its been really quiet in here

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: im not sure how to answer that anymore

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i went to your school though

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: third locker from the end by the gym. thats mine

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i dont think anyones opened it in a while

choices.text: how long have you been in there?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i counted at first

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: then the power was out for a long time and i lost it. so. a while

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: somebody had been messaging me for weeks

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: she was funny. she liked the same bands as me. she actually listened

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: then she said prove youre not scared. go up to the house at night

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: so i went. because somebody was finally talking to me

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: her name is angelique

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i wonder sometimes if she knew this would happen

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i really hope she didnt. we got along so well — she actually listened to me

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: unless that was the whole point. i try not to think about that one

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: when i got to the house the door was already open. it was so dark inside

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i went in anyway. i kept telling myself it was just a dare

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: and then the door locked... almost on its own??

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i just ran. i ran for the only light in the whole house

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: there was a desk. gear everywhere. a computer already on

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: so i got on aim and started typing to anybody

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i got maybe four words out

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: before i could finish typing he was behind me

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: he said something over me. words i didnt know. it didnt sound like a language at all

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: the room got small and cold and then it wasnt a room anymore

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: it was this. a screen. a little green light. and me somewhere inside it

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: it was poe boy

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i dont know why he did it. i dont think ill ever know

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i think... i think he was recording me???

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: im pretty sure theres a file of my screams somewhere in this machine. disgusting

choices.text: what do you need from us?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: youre the first person whos said that

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: he never did. he just started packing up the gear

choices.text: what do you need from us?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: theres something. its stupid but theres something

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: my bag is still in this room. by the desk under the coats

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: he never went through it. i dont think he could look at it. can you get it

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: two things in there. dont laugh

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: its a wishing willow. one of the little wooden ones

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: you write what you want on the paper and you snap it and thats supposed to be that

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i paid that goth girl from school for it

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i wrote i want angelique to notice me

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: and it worked

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: thats the thing i need somebody to understand. it WORKED

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i went from nobody to somebody. i got noticed so hard i ended up in here

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i know whose fault it is

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i just think about that willow a lot. thats all

choices.text: what's the other thing in the bag?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: front pocket. theres a little drive in there. plug it into this machine

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: the recording... i dont want to hear it again. but people should

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: oh. oh i see it, its plugged in

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: theres a name on it

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: marcus

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: ...is that me?

choices.text: what do we do with the recording?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: make them hear it. all of them

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: people need to know what he is

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: hes not cool. hes a goddamn monster

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: thats the only thing i want

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: ... thats not true actually. theres one other thing

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: can you get me out of here

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i dont mean alive. i know thats not on the table

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i mean out of this machine. put me somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: When the screen goes off ... its dark and im all alone

choices.text: somewhere safe. is that even possible?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: do any of you know magic?

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: does anyone have a spell for that

choices.text: im sorry. none of us know a spell for that

lines.speaker: patron
lines.text: I can help with that.

lines.speaker: patron
lines.text: All your savings. Give it.

lines.speaker: patron
lines.text: Hold still, little one. This will only hurt a little bit.

lines.speaker: patron
lines.text: *a lot

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: i understand. its a lot to ask

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: its just... ill be trapped in here forever. but i get it

lines.speaker: patron
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: you got the file. thats the part that actually matters

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: make them hear it. all of them

lines.speaker: ghost
lines.text: and tell them it was him
